verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order and grouping. The 'Set a Reminder' CTA sits above the headline, jammed against the bottom of the shoe circle. The three spec badges are scattered: '142 G' sits off to the left by the logo, 'Carbon Plate' sits above the shoe and 'Recycled Knit' floats alone under the headline. The logo is pushed off-centre to the right. B keeps a sensible order (logo, headline, shoe, specs, CTA), but the headline sits on the purple circle while the shoe slides below it, so the circle no longer frames the product. The badges form a ragged, off-axis stack ('142 G' hangs to the left). The small CTA is crammed into a tight bottom cluster just above the legal text.
